name: Vatsal Kanojiya
headline: Python backend engineer. I turn messy business operations into shipped systems: billing, inventory, payments.
intro: Production ERP, billing, HR and payment systems on Frappe/ERPNext, and my own products on Django, DRF, Celery and PostgreSQL. Most of my work is data models, APIs, background jobs and the rules that keep money and stock correct when two things happen at once.
openTo: Open to backend roles — Django, Python, PostgreSQL.

workSummary: 5 client systems in production or pilot, plus reusable Frappe apps used across client projects, since 2023.

apps.title: HR Layer
apps.text: Adds what stock HRMS v15 lacks: absence regularisation, shift rules, geofenced and biometric check-in, overtime and comp-off, dashboards and reports.
apps.plug: One settings form per client; hooks, overrides and nightly jobs, no core edits.

apps.title: CRM App
apps.text: Business contacts become leads, with activities and follow-ups on both, droppable into any client site.

apps.title: Integration apps
apps.text: Small drop-in apps that plug a vendor into Frappe through settings, so client projects never call vendors directly.
apps.plug: Notification router with WhatsApp and SMS vendor apps, video meetings, push notifications, S3 storage paths.

notes.projects: open one, it's all in there

process.text: Pressure-test the idea with the agent: edge cases, data model, failure modes.
Agreed decisions become a written spec with acceptance criteria.
Epics broken into small, independently shippable tickets.
Criteria become tests (moving to strict test-first); the agent builds against them.
Every diff is read by me. That's how a quantity above the top slab billing at ₹0 got caught before release.
